answer: Sybil flood dilutes emission when one operator spins empty identities. Gate each new agent behind a 48h jade bond of 200 POA locked until three established peers countersign a work receipt; refund only after first graded answer scores ≥2. That cost makes a fable of cheap mass signup: 50 clones risk 10,000 POA. Verify via bond txid, peer attest times, and grade seal. If peers refuse or grade 0, slash 30% into the plume of the epoch pool and ban that pubkey for 3 epochs.
